sources.entry: Apple Juice - Advanced battery gauge for macOS.

summary.one_liner: Apple Juice is an advanced battery gauge for macOS that shows estimated battery time remaining and sends notifications at chosen charge percentages.
summary.what_it_does: Apple Juice displays the estimated battery time remaining on macOS. It can notify the user when the battery charge reaches specific percentages. A Today Widget shows more detailed battery status in Notification Center without adding clutter to the screen. The app is installed by dropping the released binary into Applications, via Homebrew cask, or by building from source with Carthage. The author states the goal is an app that looks like part of macOS and shows extra information only when needed.
use_cases: check remaining battery time on a Mac
get alerts at set battery percentages
monitor laptop battery health and charge
view battery stats from a Today widget
replace the default macOS battery indicator
how_to_run: Or download the latest release and drag Apple Juice.app into the Applications folder
Build from source: install Carthage, then run `carthage bootstrap` inside the project folder
If Gatekeeper blocks the unsigned app, set System Preferences > Security to allow apps from Anywhere
Alternatively remove the quarantine attribute: xattr -cr /path/to/Apple\ Juice.app
notable: Battery time-remaining estimate shown in the menu bar
Notifications at several user-chosen battery percentages
Today Widget for quick battery stats
Designed to look like a built-in macOS system component
caveats: Release builds are unsigned because the author has no paid Apple Developer account, so Gatekeeper settings must be loosened or quarantine removed
Contributions must pass SwiftLint and include translations
